prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production pixel-art animation spritesheet of ONLY this EXACT reference monster. Preserve anatomy, body proportions, color identity and distinguishing accessory. EXACTLY FIVE ROWS x THREE COLUMNS, 15 full-body sprites, consistent body scale with transparent gutters. ROW1 battle all face LEFT three-quarter view: idle, compact attack, hurt recoil. ROW2 walk DOWN toward viewer; ROW3 walk LEFT; ROW4 walk RIGHT; ROW5 walk UP away, clear BACK view without face. Each walk row has neutral, first step, opposite step or species-appropriate flowing/hopping motion; all three different. Keep whole body inside each cell, separate rows and columns, 15% padding. Natural readable pixel clusters, enough bright highlights, crisp outlines, no blur or smooth painting, no ground, shadow, grid, letters or detached effects. Background genuinely transparent. Intended for battle96x96 displayed72px and walk32x48. Preserve accessory in every pose and direction, and keep eyes visibly luminous. Any pale gaps in the reference are background and must be transparent. Never convert this creature into a human wearing costume. HALDO: WHITE body with cool gray shadows, distinct WHITE BANDAGE wraps with readable folds, warm brown/amber eyes and flower centers. Preserve delicate white tips and silhouette completely. Clean cool-gray outline, keep white luminous rather than dirty gray. No green clasp or purple flower. Bird: eagle with original color, beak, talons and distinguishing accessory. Raised wings battle, compact talon attack. Three hopping/flapping walking poses. Back view shows back of head and wings, no eyes/beak facing backward. IMPORTANT: keep a wide fully transparent margin above highest tips and around sides; no cropped feathers, horns or claws. No colored backdrop.
